item.title: Impact rating for 01/22/2026
item.description: Impact on AMC drew 171,000 viewers last week, just 3,000 viewers down from the debut episode. A larger drop was expected but it looks like, a least for week two, TNA retained the majority of its audience. The show had a 0.03 rating in 18-49, down 0.01 from the prior week.
